name: Peacekeeper's Gamma Offers
teaser:
For any players that like their ZeroToHero runs, this is a simple mod that gives the ability to obtain a gamma container at some point from Peacekeeper.
Peacekeeper has two new barters, one for USD, and one for Beta Container-esque requirements.
description_html:
For any players that like their ZeroToHero runs, this is a simple mod that gives the ability to obtain a gamma container at some point from Peacekeeper.

Peacekeeper has two new barters, one for USD, and one for Beta Container-esque requirements.

There is a config file for some quick changes if you don’t want to use the default values.

Don’t mind the size of them, that’s just how gammas are set up for my game
